species.tagline: The red dragonfly of Shing Mun River

tasks.title: Find the big eyes
tasks.message: A dragonfly’s eyes are huge — they wrap around its head so it sees almost everywhere.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a scarlet skimmer. Its eyes are so big it can see behind itself.

tasks.title: Find the wings
tasks.message: It has four wings that move separately, so it can hover in one spot.
tasks.subtitle: A dragonfly has four wings. Moving them separately lets it hover in mid-air.

tasks.title: See the real one
tasks.hint: Tap the photo on the right
tasks.message: A real scarlet skimmer is orange-red all over, even its eyes.
tasks.subtitle: This is a photo of a real scarlet skimmer. Drag the slider to compare.

tasks.title: Where it grows up
tasks.message: Baby dragonflies grow up underwater — they need clean water to live in.
tasks.subtitle: Dragonflies live underwater when they are young. Keeping the river clean helps them grow. Thank you!
